verdict.rationale: Calendly ships its own background automations. Workflows send pre- and post-meeting emails and texts automatically, reminder emails go to people who haven't booked, routing auto-matches leads to owners from Salesforce and HubSpot, and the Callie AI assistant (beta) coordinates scheduling over email on the user's behalf. Webhook subscriptions also let developers trigger their own automations the moment events happen. Missing for 10: the docs describe the scope of Workflows triggers and actions only thinly, Callie is still beta with limited detail on how autonomous it is, and no independent or hands-on reports confirm the automations run reliably unattended.
